svg.aria-label: Perfboard layout on a 14 by 20 hole board: the front view
svg.text: Perfboard layout, front view (the ring side)
A stock 40 × 60 mm board with 14 × 20 holes, its bottom border cut off, drawn to scale. Every line is one insulated wire, lap-soldered onto the
leads at its ends; bare it where the run is short. Purple numbers are the parts off the board: the same number on the part and on the lead it joins.
battery, on the back, above this line
LiPo battery, behind the board (53 × 34 × 10 mm)
LED ring pads, on its back: about every 90°, order to check
back, standing, flat face to the edge
back, standing, flat face to the XIAO
XIAO ESP32-C3, on the back, chip and USB-C facing away from the board
Ring GND pad → Q1's collector, 1, 14 (the ring's switched ground)
Ring PWR pad → the XIAO's 3V3 pin, 11, 18
Ring DIN pad → R5's end at 7, 17
Motor red (+) → the diode's striped end, 12, 18
Motor blue (−) → the diode's plain end, 12, 15
The capacitor's + lead (2) solders onto the ring's PWR pad, with the ring's own PWR wire.
The battery's leads solder to the XIAO's BAT+ and BAT− pads (purple + and −, underneath); a sense wire runs from BAT+ through 9, 18 onto R6.
Wire on the side facing you, lapped onto the leads at its ends
Wire on the far side (A to D are the ones on the back)
Hole a wire passes up through to a XIAO pin (nothing soldered in it)
Pin or leg of a part on the far side, soldered on this side
Lead of a part on this side, going through to the far side
Outline of a part on the far side
The LED ring: only insulated wires under it
Button 1's cap skirt: nothing on the front crosses it
A case post or support presses here: keep wires off it
Screw hole: drill 3/32 in (or 2.5 mm); the screw goes in from the back
Pointer from a label to its part
